name: Buoy Morse calculator
help: Read the three buoy digits through the shield (Gondola, Recreation Yard, Model Industries). Enter a digit 0–9 or its five Morse pulses. The answer is the sum, encoded digit by digit.

name: Hut perk notebook
help: Record the perk found at each hut. Undiscovered huts stay unknown.

name: Simon Says room map & symbol matcher
help: Tap the flashing Building 64 panels on the room map. Remember the final steady lights, then match their observed monitor replacements.

Steady light at map position B
Steady light at map position C
Steady light at map position D

Steady light at map position F

name: Clock symbols → lever settings
help: Match the drawn triangle to its clock. Get exact minute/hour controls and target pointers.

name: Element → outlet route
help: Record which location sparks with each element. The pictured route puts your randomized outlets in the required trial order: Poison → Water → Electric → Fire.

name: Planet order & orb route
help: Record the Cargo Hold model’s eight flashing bodies and leave Sun last. Use the photographed destinations to follow your randomized order, one orb at a time.

name: Ra visual kill order
help: Tap the actual glyphs as they flash on the obelisk. The ordered cards show which enemy to kill next. Record a fresh display for each attempt; ordinary zombies are not sequence targets.

name: Oracle hand location finder
help: Search the Oracle’s phrase to find the exact landmark and its photograph. Select the matching clue while travelling to the hand.

fields.label: Oracle phrase
options: Beneath the Watchful Gaze of Zeus
Where the Arrow Splits the Road
Where the Serpent Snared the Eagle
Top of the Center of the World

name: Eternal Flame tribute calculator
help: Enter claimed reward counts across the whole team. A tier still waiting at the pillars is not claimed. The flame needs 9 points for every player in the match.

name: Alistair’s visual lock
help: Select the observed shape under each color. The enlarged glyphs are taken from actual gameplay screenshots; their display color is only a reference. Match shape and your recorded color at the Library case.

name: Visual zodiac & scratch solver
help: Choose the three shapes you actually see, record all three scratch groups in each area, and receive the telescope entry order. Blank means unread; zero means inspected and absent. Clear and reread clues after a failed input.

name: Stake Knife shape-to-location solver
help: Record the tree shapes left to right while facing the lantern. Then record the shape visible at each Gardens stone. The helper gives the shooting route only after both observations contain all four different shapes.

name: Project Skadi photo codes
help: Save the four codes from your match beside their identifying photographs. The entry strip keeps them in the required order: Shi No Numa, Der Riese, Shangri-La, Kino.

name: Rushmore visual clock route
help: Record the five TV clues in broadcast order. See each target clock face and room, then identify the unassigned clock and convert its observed time to Rushmore’s four-digit code.

name: Rushmore code reference & observations
help: Record all personnel codes before entering 7626 → Sawyer → McCain → Pernell. Painting codes are a later, separate batch. Optional bonus codes have their own limits.

fields.label: Optional bonus effect
options: Easy · 3279 · Slow zombies for five minutes.
Noob · 6662 · Slow zombies for five minutes.
Door · 3667 · One random unopened door becomes free.
Quiz · 1841 · Quiz dialogue; no answer input.
Guns · 4867 · All players change weapons every ten seconds for five minutes.
Shed · 7433 · Open the Yellow House backyard shed.
Fall · 3255 · Looking at zombies knocks them over.
Grav · 4728 · Kills float upward for 25 minutes.

name: Offering & Seal photo finder
help: Search a few words from the spoken clue, choose Offering or Seal, then select the matching photo. Each result gives the exact landmark and action. Your selected clue stays saved.

name: Beamsmasher visual lab solver
help: Match the three X/Y/Z notes to verified symbol images. The helper shows the three terminal entries and every calculation, including the final absolute value.

name: Strauss Counter & projector helper
help: Choose the counter reading at each photographed projector to see its required lamp color. Read each location separately; the projector color is the inverse of the counter.

fields.label: Yummy Freeze rooftop: set in game

name: Raven sword — visual ring solution
help: Choose your actual antiquity and see the exact element and zodiac images to align at the bottom pointer.

name: Tavern runes & book trap sequence
help: Record six bottle runes using actual screenshot glyphs. Switch to four book pages to match trap eyes and save their observed locations.

name: Ice Staff — rock glyphs to gateway
help: Select the three photographed rock glyphs in your match. See the matching gateway positions, verify the safe entrance and keep the escort instructions close.

fields.label: Loop with top and side marks

name: Nursery cipher decoder
help: Choose the printed protocol and copy its complete letter clusters from your current board. See every letter-to-count conversion before entering the cell code.

name: Gorgofex monitor code
help: Record the ordered monitor words, or just their initials. Confirm whether one or two monitors are active; the helper returns the atomic number with its required leading zeros.

name: S.A.M. archive order
help: Select exactly the four belongings in this match’s folders. See their real reference photos, chronological order and the resulting four-digit computer code.

name: D.I.E. port and upgrade reference
help: Match the chamber port to its real photograph. Reveal its weapon, upgrade route and prerequisites.

name: RAI K-84 visual dartboard
help: Tap the computer’s three stopped sectors in order. Get the real dartboard numbers and final bullseye.

name: CRBR-S safe and blacklight locations
help: Find each number with the nine clue photographs. Keep the three values in fixed room order.

name: Perkaholic TV sequence
help: Record the real colored screens for each 4, 8 and 12-flash stage, then follow your order one shot at a time.

name: Outbreak quest location finder
help: Choose your quest, region and objective for annotated maps, object photographs and availability checks.

name: Outbreak launch-light solver
help: Read the three small indicator lights below each A, B and D key switch. Green left is first, middle second, right third.

name: Train symbol matcher
help: Match the three red symbols seen through train windows. Select them from the sword wall below; the wall needs the collected set, not a special input order.

name: Void Bow name → symbol matcher
help: Record the three spoken names, then inspect those knights and select the symbol each actually reveals. Name-to-symbol pairings change every match.

name: Safe code & terminal memory
help: Keep the safe’s top-to-bottom code separate from the four-screen memory boards. At each station, record the small screens from left to right, then match the requested symbol.

name: Plant recipes & water locations
help: Choose what you need to grow. Find the right water in the photos, follow the three-round recipe, then record what you did in your match.

name: Valve solver with room photos
help: Find the green light and the pink cylinder. Set the other five valves as shown; leave the cylinder valve untouched. Restart the Hatchery generator if airflow expires.

name: Bomb order & location cards
help: Ignore SOPHIA’s initial fast shuffle. Record the six deliberate flashes in order, then defuse in exactly that order. Wrong input or timeout can end the run.

name: Kronorium order recorder
help: Read your scoreboard’s four collected runes from left to right as 1–4. Record which position matches each page of the book. Use your own scoreboard, not the example photograph.

name: Egg, rune, bone & relic finder
help: Choose your current collection and region for exact photographs, sightlines and the required action.

name: Samantha buttons & doll finder
help: Choose the step you are working on, narrow the locations and select any photograph to enlarge it.

help: Choose the step you are working on, narrow the locations and select any photograph to enlarge it.

name: Staff parts & secret locations
help: Choose the step you are working on, narrow the locations and select any photograph to enlarge it.

name: Ice staff symbol matcher
help: Select the pattern on the blue tablet. Shoot the matching ceiling rune with the Ice Staff, then read the next tablet.

fields.label: Tablet pattern
options: Two stacked dots · two stacked dots

name: Fire staff torch decoder
help: After lighting the Crazy Place cauldrons, select the four glowing church patterns. The result tells you which basement torches to shoot.

name: Samantha Says sequence recorder
help: Facing the four outside computers, their order is Red, Green, Blue, Yellow from left to right. Tap what flashes, then use the numbered result in-game.

name: Alley knock recorder
help: Listen to three groups at the blue Alley door. Record their counts, repeat them with melee hits, then listen for a new pattern. You must answer three different patterns.

name: Matching tile symbol notebook
help: Record the symbols revealed by your floor tiles. Give tiles your own landmark names so teammates can find the same pair; their positions change each match.

name: Gong locations & match notes
help: Test the eight photographed gongs and record the four that do not turn the crystals red. Wrong gongs reset the ringing, not which four are correct.

name: Mahjong tower order
help: Match each pictured shape to the colour seen in your match. A number and direction with the same colour tell you which tower leg to strike.

name: Mine sign cipher matcher
help: Match the first two shapes on each lantern-code line. Preserve the red stroke’s position, especially for Bone Orchard and Consumption Cross.

name: Maze lever order solver
help: Flip all four levers, then record which colours sparked. Each spark confirms that lever’s position; a dark lever rules that position out. Leave the maze together before the next attempt.

name: Mansion bell callouts
help: First test the bells with your team and map each one to its light. During the sequence, tap the lit bulb for an immediate room-and-bell callout.

name: Ice staff symbol matcher
help: Select the pattern on the blue tablet. Shoot the matching ceiling rune with the Ice Staff, then read the next tablet.

options: Two stacked dots · two stacked dots

name: Fire staff torch decoder
help: After lighting the Crazy Place cauldrons, select the four glowing church patterns. The result tells you which basement torches to shoot.

name: Lighthouse dial solver
help: Co-op quest only. Enter the four digits currently visible in your lighthouse. The answer accounts for the neighbouring dials that move with each turn.

name: Quest item & location finder
help: Choose what you are looking for, narrow by area and select a photograph to enlarge it. Use the instructions for the current step before interacting.
